I don't think this is a good idea. It could end up in hashtag abuse like we've seen on Facebook, Twitter, and other networks.
Any feature implemented could be abused, really. If the benefits outweigh the consequences then I don't see it being much of a problem. Not sure they would, but that's why this exists.

My two cents:

  1. It can be a setting that the mods can enable/disable for their own verses OR, hashtags search just inside the particular verse they are in, like CCPs required to downvote in a sub.
  2. No trends please. They are noisy trollbaits and just like Twitter/FB, will end up in too many low quality comments.
  3. Three hashtags per self post and one per comment are more than enough.
If the tags would be visible but not as visible as the actual comment/text then I would be all for this.
